lead_raw_text:
The structure of Ni6O2 (reduced formula Ni3O) crystallizes in the hexagonal space group P6_3/mmc (No. 194), with eight atoms per unit cell distributed over two independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows both Ni and O centers adopt octahedral coordination with six geometric neighbors of the opposite element, at distances of 2.08–2.11 Å. Ni-centered octahedra share edges with one another, while Ni- and O-centered octahedra share corners, forming a three-dimensional geometric neighbor network. These coordination and connectivity results are derived from the supplied geometry-only analysis.
